clinicalChecks: ARCO2019 is distinguished from undated PDF table; 3mm depression with subchondral fracture and no arthrosis correctly maps toIIIB, ≤2mm retained forIIIA. Edema alone is not a positive osteonecrosis study.
Arcuate-sign and POL questions use relevant knee alternatives and distinguish an association/targeted search from automatic complete rupture or treatment.
Source-image MCL question describes actual visible continuous ligament/periligamentous edema with lesser follow-up reaction; source two-week timing is not a universal recovery rule.

Discoid quantitative criterion preserves original Samoto inclusive20% and sagittal75% versus coronal measurement distinction; current SSR2026 midcoronal15mm and thin-slice caveat read. Old sagittalText literals are not rendered by this component; no false runtime finding inferred from dead copy.

Degenerative-meniscus treatment question includes relevant eligibility, no true locking/acute injury/advanced OA and no prior exercise. PrimaryRCT supports exercise first here, without a blanket surgery prohibition.
Bone-infarct questions distinguish medullary location, rim/centre pattern and possible coexisting osteomyelitis; absence of double-line sign is not an exclusion.
Melorheostosis image, edema caveat and targeted CT/MRI roles match actual source/image and original40-case series. No invented overlay or unseen figure claimed.
